Paint Reps

Optional. Save a rep for each catalog you buy from, since a rep can only sell their own brand. A walk or order uses the rep for the catalog it was made with. Messages open in your own messaging app and are only sent when you tap Send there.

Customer Ready Text

For paint associates. When you tap COMPLETED on an order, the app can offer a "ready for pickup" text to the customer. The text gives the order number, the job address or label (shortened if it is long), and a short count of the containers, such as 9 x 5-gal, 1 x 1-gal. It never includes colors or prices. In Paint Rep mode it appears for any order that has a phone number. In Both mode it appears only when no paint rep is saved above. Nothing is sent until you tap Send in your messaging app.

Friendly Maintenance Reminder

It's been about 30 days since your last backup.

Recommended: Create a complete business backup. This is a friendly maintenance reminder and will never block your work.

Customer Quote Setup

Your business profile, logo, and price book for PDF quotes. Saved on this device, and in your Cloud Sync account if you turn Cloud Sync on.

Business Profile

Printed at the top of your Customer Quote PDF. It is stored on this device, and in your Cloud Sync account if you turn Cloud Sync on. Only the business name is required.

Scope of work

The prep and protection you do on most jobs. Each line becomes a tick box on a quote and prints under Scope of Work, so the customer knows what is included. These are starting lines: edit them to match the work you really do. One item per line, up to 12.

Payment and customer replies

The app never takes a payment. Whatever you type here is printed on the quote, and the customer pays you however you normally get paid.

Paste a link your customer can tap to pay you in one step. It must start with https://. The best link opens straight to the payment page, with no sign-in or menu first. Open it on your phone first to make sure it works. On invoices it prints as a green PAY NOW button, and on quotes as PAY ONLINE. When Cloud Sync is on, the same Pay now button also shows on the online signing page.

Where to find your link: a PayPal.Me link, a Cash App $Cashtag link, your Venmo profile link, or a payment link made in Square or Stripe. Zelle does not have a payment link, so put your Zelle phone number or email in How to pay above instead. A link with an amount already filled in works only for that amount, so use Payment link for this invoice on the invoice for those.

The app never takes the payment. Your customer pays through the service you choose, and that service's own terms and fees apply.

Adds Accept, Question or changes, and Decline buttons to the PDF. When Cloud Sync is on, the online signing page also lets the customer send you a question or a decline straight from that page (an invoice gets a question box only). You are emailed a copy, and it comes into the quote at the next sync. A button opens a short reply page on the developer's website. The customer picks text or email there, and their own app opens with a message already written to the phone number or email above. The app cannot see the reply, and the reply page does not store it.

Sales tax

Optional. A percent you set, added to quotes, change orders and invoices. The app only calculates it. It is not tax advice, and the rules differ by state and by what you sell.

Charge tax on

Invoices and reminders

These settings drive the due dates and the alerts on your Home screen.

The logo is resized on this device and saved with a white background. Tap Choose File to pick an image.

Price Book

Your own shelf prices by catalog, product, container and sheen. Enter the lowest sheen as the base price; each higher sheen is estimated by adding the sheen step, and you can type an exact price for any sheen. Prices you type on a quote are saved here and reused. Nothing here is sent anywhere.

Labor Rates

How fast your crew works. For a quote you can choose Labor: Hours from my rates. The app takes the measurements and coats on the walk, divides by your rates, and gives you an hours estimate you can change. Nothing is filled in until you enter it, and every number here is yours.

Line Items

Things you charge for often, such as a repair, prep or a fee. In a quote or change order, pick one from Saved line items to fill a line in one tap. The prices start empty: enter yours once and they are filled in every time. Change, delete or add your own. Everything here is yours, and is saved on this device (and in your Cloud Sync account if you turn Cloud Sync on).

Add your own

Money Hub

Quotes, invoices, what is owed, your pipeline, exports and quote setup. Stored on this device, and in your Cloud Sync account if you turn Cloud Sync on.

The app cannot see payments or replies. The numbers come from what you record on each quote, invoice and change order.

The pipeline report is part of a subscription.

Bookkeeper CSV lists every quote, invoice, payment and change order, with the lead source and job stage.

QuickBooks makes a Customers file, an Invoices file and a Payments list that you import into QuickBooks Online yourself.

Phone calendar adds the due date of every unpaid invoice to your calendar.

Legal & Disclaimers

Paint Project Manager V4.0 · Rev AL

Estimate Use

Paint Project Manager is an estimating and workflow aid. Calculations, coverage, quantities, product selections, pricing, availability, measurements, job conditions, and order details must be reviewed before use. The app does not replace field verification, product instructions, store procedures, or professional judgment.

Local Data & Privacy

Project records are stored on this device. Protect access to the device and exported backup files. Export data before changing devices or clearing browser storage. A backup can be protected with a passphrase, which encrypts it on this device. A forgotten passphrase cannot be recovered, and a backup made without one is not encrypted. Do not enter information that is unnecessary for the estimate or order workflow. Messages to a paint rep or to a customer are created on your device and are sent only when you review them and send them yourself from your own messaging app. Unless you turn on the optional Cloud Sync described at the end of this section, your Business Profile, logo, Price Book, saved line items, and Customer Quotes are stored only on this device and in backup files you export. A quote PDF is created on your device and leaves it only when you share or save it yourself. Reply buttons in a quote PDF, and the back-up text and email buttons on the online signing page, open a short reply page on the developer's website (arcanedigitalmining.com). The message and contact details travel in the part of the web address after the # symbol, which browsers do not send to the server, so the page does not receive, store, or send the reply. It only opens the reader's own text or email app with the message already written, and nothing is sent until the reader presses Send. Like any website, the developer's web host may keep ordinary access records, such as the time of a visit and the visitor's IP address. Invoices, change orders, signatures, photos, production rates, job tracking details, and payment records you enter are stored on this device and in backup files you export. If you turn on the optional Cloud Sync, your projects, orders, quotes, invoices, and signatures are also stored in your Cloud Sync account, as described at the end of this section. Photos are not synced. QuickBooks files and phone-calendar files are created on your device and leave it only when you share or save them yourself. They can include customer names, phone numbers, and addresses. The app does not connect to QuickBooks or to your calendar, and once a file is in another service, that service's own terms and privacy policy apply, including a cloud calendar that syncs events to your other devices. Report a Problem writes a message on your device containing what you type, the app version, the kind of phone and browser, the screen you were on, your Contractor, Paint Rep, or Both setting, your screen size, whether you were online, the number of saved projects, how much storage the app uses, and recent error messages (with quoted text, web addresses, email addresses, and long numbers removed). It does not include customer or job details unless you type them, so leave them out. It leaves your device only when you send it yourself. It reaches the developer as an email that includes your email address, which is used only to understand and fix the problem and to reply to you. The app has no advertising, analytics, or crash reporting. Accounts are optional and are used only for Cloud Sync. If you do not create an account and turn Cloud Sync on, the developer does not receive your project data. If you turn Cloud Sync on, your projects, orders, quotes, invoices, and business settings (including your Business Profile, Price Book, rates, and rep contacts), and the email address for your account, are sent over an encrypted connection (HTTPS) to the developer's server and stored there so your devices stay in step. Photos are not synced. You can turn sync off or sign out at any time, and you can delete your account and everything stored in the cloud from Settings → Cloud Sync. Your data on this device is not deleted when you do. The full Privacy Policy is available from the developer at findain@gmail.com.

Customer Signatures Online

If you turn on Cloud Sync, a quote or invoice PDF can include a Review & Sign button. When you create that PDF, a copy of the quote or invoice (your business name and contact details, the customer's name, the job, the scope, the prices, the balance, any payment link you saved, and the notes) is stored on the developer's server so the customer can open it from the link in the PDF. Anyone who has the link can read that quote or invoice, including its balance and any payment link on it, and can sign it, so send the PDF only to your customer. When the customer signs, their typed name, their drawn signature, and the time are stored on the server, and they come into your quote the next time the app syncs. The copy is deleted when you set the job's Job Stage to Complete or Lost, 30 days after the link expires if the quote was never signed, 12 months after the signature if the job is never marked complete, or when you delete your cloud account, whichever comes first. If the customer uses the question or decline form on that page, the message they type, the name they enter, and any phone number or email they choose to add are also stored on the server, and a copy is emailed to the email address of your account. They come into your quote or invoice the next time the app syncs, and are deleted at the same times as the signing copy, or after 90 days, whichever comes first. The signing page does not use cookies, analytics, or tracking. Like any website, the developer's web host may keep ordinary access records, such as the time of a visit and the visitor's IP address. A signature saved this way is a record of the customer's agreement to that quote or invoice. It is not a certified e-signature service, it is not proof of payment, and you are responsible for checking whether it is enough for your jobs. The name typed on the signing page, and any message or contact detail a customer enters, are not verified. Anyone who has a signing link can also send a message through the page. Do not type, and tell your customers not to type, private information such as card or bank details into the message box. Online signing and customer messages depend on the developer's server and on the customer's connection. They are a convenience, and there is no guarantee that a link will open, that a message will arrive, or that the email copy will reach you (check your Junk folder). Keep your phone number and email on your documents, and do not rely on these features as your only way to hear from a customer. The Pay now button on the signing page only opens the payment link you saved. The payment is handled by that service, not by this app or the developer.

Subscriptions

In the Google Play version, a subscription, which may begin with a free trial, is sold and billed by Google Play. The developer does not receive or store your payment card details. Google Play tells the app whether your subscription is active, and the app keeps a copy of that answer on this device so it can keep working offline for a short time. If your trial or subscription ends, your data stays on this device, and in your Cloud Sync account if you use one. You can still open existing projects, place and finish their orders, see your saved records, and export a backup or a CSV. Starting new projects, Quick Orders and reorders, and making new quotes, invoices and other documents, need an active subscription. Billing, cancellation, and refunds are handled by Google Play.

No Purchase Processing

The app supports estimating, shopping-list, mixing, staging, and reorder workflows. It does not complete payment, purchasing, delivery, warranty, or customer-contract functions. It does not contact any retailer, paint rep, or customer on its own. Customer quotes, invoices, change orders and work orders are documents you create and send yourself. The app does not take payments, send messages to your customers on its own (a reminder button only opens your own messaging app with a message you read and send yourself), or give tax, legal or accounting advice. Sales tax is a percentage you set; the app only calculates it. Payment instructions or links printed on a quote or invoice are typed by you; the app does not take, process, or see any payment. A Pay now button on an invoice or on the online signing page only opens the payment link you typed. The payment is handled by that service under its own terms and fees. The developer does not take, see, or confirm it, the app cannot tell whether an invoice was paid, and you are responsible for the link being correct and for recording payments yourself. A reply a customer sends by text or email from a PDF button goes to your own phone or email and is not received by this app. A question or decline a customer sends from the online signing page is stored on the developer's server and comes into the app when you next sync (see Customer Signatures Online). A reply is a written message, not a signature. A signature captured on this device or on the online signing page is a record of the customer's agreement. It is not a certified electronic-signature service and it is not proof of payment, so have your contract wording reviewed.

Your Customers' Information

You may enter your customers' names, phone numbers, addresses, photos, and signatures. A customer who uses the online signing page may also type a name, a message, and a phone number or email. These details are customer information too. You are responsible for using that information lawfully, for keeping this device and your backups secure, and for any notices your customers are owed under the law. Photograph customer property only when you are authorized to.

Independent Application & Trademarks

Paint Project Manager is an independent product. It is not sponsored by, endorsed by, approved by, affiliated with, associated with, or connected to any retailer, paint manufacturer, supplier, or brand referenced in the app, including but not limited to Lowe's, The Home Depot, Sherwin-Williams, Benjamin Moore, and the product brands in the app's catalogs, such as HGTV HOME by Sherwin-Williams, Valspar, Cabot, ProBlock, BEHR, Glidden, Olympic, Ready Seal, and KILZ, and their respective affiliates, subsidiaries, and product lines.

All trademarks, registered trademarks, service marks, trade names, brand names, product names, product-line and series names, and logos referenced in this app are the property of their respective owners. They appear only as plain text, solely to identify the products and retailers they refer to, and for no other purpose. Their use does not imply any sponsorship, endorsement, partnership, or relationship, and no rights in any such mark are claimed.

Product lists, sheens, container sizes, and availability are provided for convenience and planning only. They may be incomplete, out of date, or different from what a retailer actually carries. Always confirm products, sizes, colors, and pricing with your supplier before ordering. The app does not supply prices or purchasing guarantees from any retailer or manufacturer. Every price in a Customer Quote is a price you entered yourself, and the quote is your own quote to your customer, not an offer from any retailer, manufacturer, or paint rep.

The loading screens and Home screens use original artwork created for this app. They show no retailer, manufacturer, or product logos, packaging, or brand marks. Third-party names appear only as plain text, as described above.
